1.name: Green Vow
1.desc: When Remie enters the battlefield, she gains the maximum amount of Special <color=#FFFFFF>[Radiance]</color>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180 seconds. When Remie triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> effect, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist: Feather Wheel Dance]</color>, she gains 200 Decibels, and this effect can trigger at most once every 18 seconds. While Remie is in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Phase Shift Flow]</color> state, Attribute Anomaly Damage Dealt by teammates is increased by 10%.

2.name: Cascading Clamor
2.desc:
Remie's <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringence]</color> increases to 2. When triggering a <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringe]</color> reaction, up to 2 <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> will be consumed. When 2 <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> are consumed, the <color=#FFA9DD>[Mutation Coefficient]</color> of this <color=#FFA9DD>[Refringe]</color> increases by 25%.
Additionally, while the character is in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Phase Flux]</color> state, the frequency at which auto-activated Support Skills apply <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> to enemies increases, and the number of <color=#FFA9DD>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> applied per skill also increases from 1 to 2.

4.name: The Long Goodbye
4.desc: When Remie triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> effect, DMG Multiplier is additionally increased by 12%; after Remie enters the battlefield and gains the maximum number of special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color>, if all <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color> are consumed within 30s, the maximum number of special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color> can be obtained once more. The effect of gaining special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color> again disappears after triggering 1 time or when Remie enters the <color=#FFFFFF>[Phase-Shift Flow]</color> state.

5.name: The Wayfarer Drinks Deep of Oblivion

6.name: Wings of a Thousand Beats
6.desc: When Remie uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Drooping Rainbow]</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Fleeting Swan]</color>, she triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> effect 2 times; if the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> lands on a target, Remie gains 3 special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color> after the skill ends. The DMG dealt by special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color> obtained this way is 20% of that from special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color> gained upon entering the battlefield.
